title: 15 Lazygit Features In Under 15 Minutes
summary: The author of lazygit demos 15 features of his terminal UI for git, such as staging individual lines and easier rebasing, aimed at making common git tasks simpler.
why: Recommended as the author's own quick intro to lazygit, a TUI that makes git workflows more natural.

quote.text: There is a nice video from the author that introduces a lot of its features.
